jobs.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, filmed on a good camera in a warm studio, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
jobs.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~62 за столом в тёплой студии, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей и логотипов
jobs.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
jobs.meaning: ведущий ~62, седые зачёсанные волосы, загорелый, тёмно-синий свитер на молнии, стол, тёплая студия
jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame of a calm, wise Russian man about 62 with thick silver-grey hair combed back, tanned lined face, light grey eyes, clean-shaven, wearing a dark navy knitted quarter-zip sweater over a white t-shirt. He sits at a dark wooden desk with a few sheets of paper in front of him, forearms resting on the desk, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm confident fatherly expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the chest up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: a warm studio wall with soft sunset orange and terracotta light and a green palm plant on the right, softly blurred. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
